product_offering.core_offering: Lithic operates a programmable card issuing and money movement platform that lets businesses, fintechs, and enterprises programmatically create and manage virtual and physical payment cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) via a REST API. The platform combines direct DEX/MIP network connections, an embedded ledger, ACH/wires, KYC/KYB, tokenization, and Program Management services so customers can launch debit, credit, and prepaid programs at scale with configurable authorization and real-time settlement.
product_offering.differentiator: Lithic is built from first principles as a direct processor with direct connections to card networks (DEX to Visa, MIP to Mastercard, and American Express) and the Federal Reserve, unlike embedded middleware competitors that sit on top of legacy processors. It offers dedicated BINs and 25+ sponsor bank integrations, a clear Graduation Path to self-management, configurable AI-powered authorization intelligence, comprehensive Program Management services regardless of whether Lithic acts as program manager or pure processor, and developer-friendly APIs with an MCP Server.
product_offering.functional_benefit: Direct to banks and networks, 99.99%+ uptime, multi-currency processing, AI-powered authorization with 25+ rule attributes and backtesting, real-time reconciliation via webhooks and Settlement API, embedded ledger with financial accounts, ACH and wire transfers, managed disputes and 3DS, tokenization and digital wallet provisioning, KYC/KYB, instant card issuance, custom card printing, mobile and web provisioning, and 24/7 cardholder support.
product_offering.problem_solved: Replacing legacy, poorly documented, and slow-moving card issuing infrastructure with a modern, developer-friendly, API-first platform that connects directly to card networks and sponsor banks. Lithic enables rapid launch of card programs (debit, credit, prepaid), reduces operational complexity through Program Management services, and provides transparent reconciliation and authorization controls.
quantifiable_outcome: Handles hundreds of millions of dollars of monthly volume without issue (Flex)
Issues hundreds of thousands of single and multi-use virtual cards annually via the Lithic API (Order.co)
Enterprise issuing volumes tripled in four months (2021)
99.99%+ platform uptime with no scheduled downtime
100+ high-growth clients with billions in spend
product_offering.product_overview: Lithic operates as a unified card-issuing platform with a modular architecture: the Card Issuing API is the core engine, augmented by add-on modules for Accounts & Payment Hub, Program Management, Fraud & Risk Controls, and lifecycle services (Processing Only, Graduation Path). Built directly into the Visa, Mastercard, and American Express networks, the platform exposes authorization, settlement, ACH, and wire-transfer rails through a single REST API. Solution packages — Agentic Commerce, Credit, Digital Banking, Disbursements, Fleet, and Stablecoin — bundle the underlying modules for specific vertical use cases across industries such as bill pay, corporate incentives, expense management, healthcare payments, insurance payouts, marketing & ad spend, rewards & loyalty, and travel.

Closed a $60 million Series C led by Stripes at an $800 million post-money valuation, bringing total capital raised to $110 million to fund team expansion, acquisitions, and international growth.

Lithic, a card-issuing technology company, is expanding into Canada to enable businesses to facilitate international growth and manage transactions in multiple currencies. The expansion introduces multicurrency processing capabilities, physical cards with offline PIN management, and quicker program launch times.
recent_move.title: Canada Expansion

expansion_highlight.description: Lithic launched in Canada in September 2024 with multicurrency processing, physical cards with offline PIN management, and faster program launch, signaling a clear intent to expand beyond the US into cross-border programs.

April 2026 launch of the Lithic MCP Server brings Lithic APIs into AI editors (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot), and August 2025 partnership with Arcade.dev introduced agentic commerce with just-in-time authentication, opening a new product surface tied to AI-driven purchasing.

Coinstar partnership (December 2025) and Stelrix investment-backed credit card program (November 2025) show Lithic moving into consumer cash-conversion and investment-backed credit, verticals beyond its historical fintech and expense-management base.

Stearns Bank BIN sponsorship partnership (January 2026) and existing 25+ sponsor bank integrations indicate systematic expansion of the partner bank network to support more program types and geographies.

Solutions packaging for Agentic Commerce, Credit, Digital Banking, Disbursements, Fleet, and Stablecoin, combined with industry-specific verticals (Healthcare, Insurance, Marketing & Ad Spend), signals a deliberate move upmarket and into larger enterprise segments beyond fintech startups.

Headcount sits in the 101-250 range with named C-level executives including a CFO, COO, CCO, and CPO, plus functional heads across engineering, marketing, compliance, and payment operations, consistent with a scaling organization positioned for further expansion.
